slides.title: An open agent ecosystem
lines: Agents that can do useful work
narration: Astral Deep is an open ecosystem for agents that can do useful work.
We're building it around a simple goal: people should understand what an agent can do, even when it delegates.

slides.title: Authority follows the task
narration: An agent may discover a tool, ask another agent for help, or act on sensitive information.
Each step needs a clear identity and permission boundary.
Finding a capability should never grant permission to use it.

slides.title: Bounded delegation with LETS
narration: With LETS enforcement enabled, delegation has explicit limits.
A child lease receives only a bounded share of its parent's authority and resource budget, with an expiry.
The executor verifies and durably claims a receipt before the protected action.

slides.title: Checks at the action boundary
narration: Astral Deep's design keeps identity, tool policy, and owner isolation on the normal dispatch path.
Sensitive actions need the appropriate checks and confirmation.
Audit provenance helps explain who authorized an action and how authority reached it.

slides.title: Generative UI with primitives
narration: Useful agents also need useful interfaces.
A model can propose a form, table, or chart using structured UI primitives.
Code checks component types and references, bounds the layout, and escapes web content before rendering.
The model proposes. Code decides.

slides.title: One contract across clients
narration: Astral Primitives defines the vocabulary.
Astral Projection renders and adapts it for web and native clients.
Astral Deep orchestrates the work, while Astral Plane owns durable state.
The goal is consistent meaning across devices, with components other developers can reuse.

slides.title: Open protocols and reusable parts
narration: We want these parts to connect through standard M C P, Agent to Agent, and other agent communication protocols.
That means versioned contracts, compatibility tests, and examples that work outside the full Astral stack.

slides.title: Work that moves this forward
narration: There is concrete work to do.
Help test delegation boundaries, improve protocol compatibility, or make voice survive interruptions and reconnects, especially on mobile.
Better primitive rendering, client parity, and independent examples can make the system useful to more developers.

slides.title: A place to contribute
narration: The bounty board turns these goals into tasks across five repositories.
Choose a task, request a claim, and wait for your reservation before starting.
Accepted, reviewed work earns recognition points on the leaderboard.
Join us at astral deep dot github dot I O.
